title: Panel summary v1 — data/votes/<run>/_panel.json (written by run-panel.ps1; its presence marks the run as voted)

consensus.description: Sorted best-first. score = mean over voting models of (+conf if keep, -conf if cut), range -100..100. veto (optional, 2026-11-19+) is true when any voting model cut; one cut is enough to drop the leg. Older files without veto still validate; treat cut>=1 as a veto.

veto.description: Optional: true if any voting model cut this leg
